checks.title: Digital-service supply classification and customer status
checks.verify: Classify the supplied service, customer status and relevant Member States before applying TBE/electronic-services rules. Do not treat every online service as an electronically supplied service without legal review.

checks.title: B2C TBE/electronic-service place of supply
runtime_tests: Using synthetic consumer orders from different Member States, verify the tax engine resolves the intended customer country and applies the configured VAT treatment consistently.
checks.verify: Review VAT Directive place-of-supply rules for B2C telecommunications, broadcasting and electronic services. The general rule places these supplies where the customer belongs, subject to the EUR 10,000 threshold conditions and other exceptions.

checks.title: EUR 10,000 cross-border threshold eligibility
runtime_tests: Recalculate current and preceding calendar-year totals for cross-border TBE services and relevant intra-EU distance sales; verify the threshold logic switches treatment when the aggregate threshold is exceeded.
checks.verify: Review the EUR 10,000 threshold conditions. It is not a general digital-business threshold: it applies only where the supplier is established in a single Member State and the relevant current/preceding-year supplies stay within the threshold.

checks.title: Customer-location evidence for electronic services
runtime_tests: Inspect the evidence used to determine customer location for representative electronic-service orders, including billing/payment/geolocation evidence where applicable, and verify contradictory evidence is handled rather than silently ignored.
checks.verify: Review Implementing Regulation (EU) No 282/2011 customer-location presumptions and evidence rules. Depending on circumstances and turnover, one or two qualifying items of evidence may be relevant; do not hard-code a universal 'two proofs' rule.

checks.title: Cross-border B2B service place-of-supply and customer status
runtime_tests: Using synthetic business customers, verify VAT ID/customer-status checks, invoice/tax treatment and reverse-charge configuration where the applicable place-of-supply rules require it.
checks.verify: Review the VAT Directive B2B place-of-supply rule and Article 196 reverse-charge conditions. A supplied VAT number alone should not be treated as conclusive without appropriate validation.

checks.title: One Stop Shop registration and reporting workflow
runtime_tests: Reconcile synthetic cross-border B2C sales by Member State against the OSS export/return data; verify customer-country VAT rate, taxable amount, corrections and payment/reporting ownership.
checks.verify: Review the applicable OSS scheme, Member State of Identification, covered supplies and current reporting rules. OSS is a simplification mechanism, not a substitute for determining place of supply and taxable treatment.

checks.title: Customer-country VAT rates and supporting records
runtime_tests: Compare configured VAT rates for representative Member States with current national/EU sources and verify transaction records preserve the data needed to support customer location, rate selection and reported amounts.
checks.verify: VAT rates vary by Member State and can change. Verify the current rate applicable to the specific service and retain supporting records required by the applicable scheme and national law.

limitations: This pack is limited to selected EU digital-service VAT/OSS readiness and does not cover all VAT, customs, marketplace, invoicing or national tax obligations.
The EUR 10,000 threshold is conditional and not available to every supplier; Beacon does not infer threshold eligibility from revenue alone.
VAT rates and national implementation details must be rechecked against current sources.
European Commission 2026 OSS guidance includes ViDA changes that start entering into force from 1 January 2027; re-check the then-current rules before releases crossing that date.
A PASS reflects supplied evidence for a modeled readiness check, not tax advice or a tax-authority determination.
